A custom data_as_elements list names the elements to convert

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = '<div><section data-as="p">First</section><section data-as="p">Second</section></div>'
    options = ConversionOptions(data_as_elements=["section"])
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
